owns.rule: One owned connection factory is the only supported authoritative SQLite entry point and proves foreign-key enforcement on every connection.
Migration identity/order/content/manifest governance, serialized application, atomic schema+ledger publication, drift detection, and readiness gating are Foundation Runtime responsibilities.
Status inspection is side-effect free and cannot implicitly initialize, migrate, repair, checkpoint, or create diagnostics merely by observation.
Named/versioned JSON document validation and upgrade mechanics are centrally governed while document meaning remains with its owning domain/runtime capability.
Restart-relevant job/checkpoint/proposal coordination uses explicit durable records and never depends only on browser or process memory.
Common rules cover FK enforcement, effective FK indexes, schema publication checks, rollback/retry behavior, and no-partial-publication guarantees.

shared_with.boundary: HLD-14 defines what audit/event/history means and when it is required; HLD-02 provides append-only relational persistence/transaction mechanics.

shared_with.capability: local runtime registry and shutdown coordination
shared_with.mechanical_owner: HLD-02 where durable/SQLite interaction is required
shared_with.boundary: Registry trust/authentication is not persistence authority.

shared_with.mechanical_owner: HLD-02 for database integrity validation and reopen/publication checks

does_not_own.capability: domain entities, business transitions, lifecycle meaning, and cross-domain relationship semantics
cryptographic algorithms, key storage, backup-envelope security, redaction policy

authority_rules: A database convenience cannot override owning-domain semantics.
A migration may change representation but may not silently change accepted product behavior.
A JSON document may not become an escape hatch for independently queryable relational facts.
A cache/projection may be dropped and rebuilt without loss of canonical truth.
A technical runtime record may coordinate work but never become domain lifecycle authority.
